implementation_notes.note: run_command now detaches subprocess stdin with subprocess.DEVNULL, keeps UTF-8/errors=replace capture, and converts subprocess.TimeoutExpired into a fail-loud MultiAlphaCombineBacktestError with node_id, workspace, backtest_name, stage, command, timeout, stdout_tail, and stderr_tail context. Shell executor qrun/read_exp/custom calls pass stage-specific context. Regression coverage includes a real node_parallelism=2 WSL smoke using two concurrent wsl bash -lc children, timeout failure propagation, and per-child workspace isolation.
